evals.prompt: Add technical SEO metadata, Open Graph tags, and JSON-LD Organization schema to a Next.js homepage.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements title, description, canonical, OG tags, Twitter card tags, and JSON-LD script in the page head.
expectations: Open Graph and Twitter Card social preview tags included
JSON-LD Organization schema block present and valid

evals.prompt: Generate a sitemap.xml and robots.txt for a Next.js app with public routes /home, /features, /pricing and private /dashboard.
evals.expected_output: sitemap.xml lists only the three public routes with lastmod and priority; robots.txt blocks /dashboard and /api.
expectations: sitemap.xml includes /home, /features, /pricing with correct lastmod format
